name: cfordo
description: Playbook-driven workflows for Cloudflare Workflows, Queues and D1.

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: pnpm build && tsrs --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && tsrs --noEmit -p test/types/tsconfig.json && pnpm test:core && node --test test/workers.test.mjs
scripts.test:core: esbuild test/entry.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external --loader:.sql=text --outfile=test/.build/core.mjs && node --test test/ordo.test.mjs test/context.test.mjs test/core/*.test.mjs test/db/*.test.mjs
